voice.name: James - French Podcast
voice.why: A friendly middle-aged Frenchman speaking English: the island's shopkeepers (supermarket, gun counter, pharmacy, clothing) all speak through the core shopkeeper dialogue, so they share one brisk shopkeeper voice.

rumor_asked_today.text: I have told you what I know today. Ask again tomorrow.

greet.text: Good day. Take what you need from the shelves and pay at the till.

how_to_pay.text: Pick the goods up yourself, then pay at any till before you leave. You get a receipt. Walk out without paying and the alarm goes off.

stock.text: Food and household goods on the shelves, drinks in the chilled counter. What runs out comes back from the stockroom every few minutes.

thief.text: Stop! You did not pay for that! Come back here!
